journey: MVP M2: senior resident finds a textile repair clinic

inputs.purpose: Prototype requirements M2.1 and M2.2, screens 5 and 6
Official Boston component and visual guidance
Existing React, TypeScript, Vite, and TanStack Router boundaries

constraints: Use the current textile MVP, a 390-pixel mobile viewport, and Fleet conventions.
Treat the older television persona and technical prototypes as historical context.
Use two synthetic clinics. Do not infer that the backend supports the mock fields.
Separate source facts, AI suggestions, and unresolved decisions.
Do not implement production code, query paid APIs, collect personal data, or publish to Slack.
title: Generate and compare two clinic wireframes
objective: Make two layout alternatives concrete enough to compare before visual styling.
in_scope: Two low-fidelity alternatives for results and filters
out_of_scope: Additional screens or redesigning the Boston entry frame

ai_steps.prompt: Read the accepted UI-002 specification. Suggest two distinct information hierarchies for the same 390-pixel results/filter flow. Keep the content and requirements identical. Explain a trade-off for each in at most 200 words. Do not choose the winner for the design owner.

Generate editable grayscale wireframes for both alternatives in Figma or self-contained HTML. Use no more than six frames total. Show two clinic cards, filter controls, a partial match, and an empty result. Connect open filters, apply machines available, clear, and return. Use synthetic clinics and no live backend.

Compare the wireframes against the acceptance cases and keyboard/focus expectations. Report only visible or reproducible gaps. Export previews and write at most 300 words comparing the alternatives. Ask me to explain my recommendation before the design owner selects one.

deliverables.name: wireframes
deliverables.format: Editable Figma link or self-contained HTML
deliverables.contents: Two alternatives and one linked flow, at most six frames total.

deliverables.name: wireframe-previews
deliverables.contents: 390-pixel previews identifying the alternative and state.

deliverables.name: wireframe-decision.md
deliverables.contents: At most 300 words with trade-offs, observed checks, and the human selection.

acceptance: Both alternatives implement the same accepted UI-002 behavior.
A reviewer can follow filter application and clearing without a spoken explanation.
The chosen flow shows two clinics becoming one when machines are required.
Focus order and announced state changes are annotated or demonstrated.
The design owner records the selected alternative and unresolved concerns.
learning_check: Explain why the selected layout helps this resident and where the other alternative would be better.
handoff: UI-004 uses only the selected wireframe revision.
